title: Hoodlum Soldier Ep 8: Coming Home

scenes.say: Ali comes home to Newark a different man in the same streets.
scenes.visual: a man with a duffel bag walking down a Newark block in daylight, seen from behind, cinematic film still, moody color grade, no text

scenes.say: Same corners. Same faces. Some gone. Some locked up.
scenes.visual: an empty street corner with a faded memorial of candles and photos, cinematic film still, moody color grade, no text

scenes.say: The block wants to know if he's still Ali.
scenes.visual: young men on a stoop watching a figure walk past, faces shadowed, cinematic film still, moody color grade, no text

scenes.say: He doesn't know the answer either.
scenes.visual: a man standing in front of a cracked mirror in a small bathroom, cinematic film still, moody color grade, no text

scenes.say: At night, a car backfires and he's on the floor.
scenes.visual: a man crouched on a bedroom floor in the dark, streetlight through blinds, cinematic film still, moody color grade, no text

scenes.say: His heart is in the desert. His body is on Clinton Avenue.
scenes.visual: a split mood scene of desert sand blending into a city street at night, cinematic film still, moody color grade, no text

scenes.say: Moms leaves the porch light on every night anyway.
scenes.visual: a single porch light glowing on a Newark rowhouse at night, cinematic film still, moody color grade, no text

scenes.say: She cooks his favorite meal and doesn't ask a single question.
scenes.visual: a home cooked plate of rice and beans on a kitchen table, warm light, cinematic film still, moody color grade, no text

scenes.say: Love doesn't fix it. But it holds the door open.
scenes.visual: a front door left slightly open with warm light spilling out, cinematic film still, moody color grade, no text

scenes.say: He's home. He's just not back yet.
scenes.visual: a man sitting on porch steps at night, head bowed, seen from behind, cinematic film still, moody color grade, no text

scenes.say: Follow for Episode Nine. Turn negative into positive.
scenes.visual: a duffel bag resting by a front door at dawn, cinematic film still, moody color grade, no text

caption: HOODLUM SOLDIER, Episode 8 of 25: Coming Home. The true-story series from the book by Elvin Torres Sr. New episode every 48 hours.
